event.label: Graduation at Marburg – Bernard Andreae
event.note: Bernard Andreae graduated from Marburg in 1956 under Friedrich Matz, specializing in Roman sarcophagi; his thesis analyzed historical motifs within sarcophagus iconography.

event.label: Habilitation at Bonn – Bernard Andreae
event.note: In 1962, he completed his habilitation in Bonn with a monograph on Roman funerary art ("Studien zur roemischen Grabkunst"), dedicated to his mentors Friedrich Matz, Reinhard Herbig, and Ernst Langlotz.

event.label: Excavation at Tiberius's Villa in Sperlonga – Bernard Andreae
event.note: In the 1970s and 1980s, he tracked the Rome Soprintendenza's excavations at Tiberius's Villa in Sperlonga, producing complex reconstructions of the Hellenistic-Roman sculpture groups.

event.label: Excavation at Baiae – Bernard Andreae
event.note: This interest also drove his research at Hadrian's Villa and the Baiae excavations, where he served as scientific director for underwater research.
